name: PlayerCharacter
description: The body a player controls in the world. A level selects the character spawned for each player in World Settings.

methods.name: on_spawned
methods.doc: Called when the character is placed in the world.

methods.name: on_possessed
methods.doc: Called when a controller takes control of this character.

methods.name: on_unpossessed
methods.doc: Called when its controller lets go.
